test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A rectangular field is 16 meters long and 12 meters wide. A barbed fence has to be drawn on three sides of the field leaving one side open along the width. What is the cost of fencing at the rate of 25 paise per cm?
solution:
**Given:**

Dimensions of rectangular field = 16 m × 12 m 

Cost of fencing = 25 paise per cm 

**Formula used:**

Length of rectangular field with one side open = 2 × Length + Breadth 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4eb725b69d7adbd303d97698fa3d194789990fa9c031bd8e28a2fcc35ca702cc.png] 

Length of field = 2 × 16 m + 12 m 

⇒ 44 m = 4400 cm 

∴ Cost of fencing at 25 paise per cm = 4400 cm × 25/100 

**⇒ Rs.1100**
